checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are accurate and rigorous. It correctly identified that while the image mimics the *layout* of a menu, it fails the functional definition due to illegible text. Specifically, marking 'structured typography' and 'systematic listing' as false is correct because AI-generated pseudo-text does not constitute structured data. The Router did not skip any testable checkpoints.
artifact_review: The Router correctly flagged 'text_gibberish' as a severity 5 artifact. This is the defining failure of the image. The 'image_text_auditor' confirmed this with low confidence scores (mostly <0.65) and nonsensical extracted strings ('gongis', 'peunot'). The Router also noted 'structural_collapse' in the logo (severity 3), which aligns with the visual melting of the top-left graphic. The 'perceptual_quality_auditor' noted slight blur, but this is negligible compared to the semantic failure of the text. No artifacts were underestimated; if anything, the text gibberish is so severe it dominates all other quality metrics.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails almost all functional checkpoints. The 'fine_grained_classifier' failed to identify it as a 'menu' (ranking it 3rd behind 'slide rule' and 'binder'), indicating that even global features are ambiguous. Only the material texture (paper) and vague branding shapes passed. The complete lack of readable text means it cannot function as a menu, resulting in a very low alignment score despite the visual resemblance.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic text generation failure. The 'image_text_auditor' extracted pure gibberish with low confidence, confirming the 'text_gibberish' artifact (Severity 5). Additionally, the logo area shows structural melting (Severity 3). The paper texture is acceptable, but the primary content (text) is structurally collapsed into noise. This warrants a very low artifact score, similar to or slightly better than the 'bannister' reference which had structural issues, but here the issue is semantic/functional collapse.
key_defects: Text Gibberish: All text on the menu is nonsensical, malformed, and unreadable.
